# Margin (margin.bible)

Hosted Bible reader + notes. Rails 8.1.

- Address = OSIS slug (jhn.3.16). grab-bcv names it; Rails stores it.
- The page is always a chapter, with BSB pericope headings.
- Notes: one record per library + slug. Compose, don’t absorb.
- route.bible is outbound only: https://route.bible/{slug}
- Auth: cookie library, then magic link.
- legacy/ is the old Elixir/pack/Expo demo. Do not deploy it.

Agent conventions: AGENTS.md
